content: Cangkhainae ka ngai e teh panuenae hah a ngai toe,

content.text: hatei yuenae ka hmuhma e teh tamipathu doeh.
Tami kahawi ni teh BAWIPA ni ngaikhai e hah ouk a hmu,
hatei hawihoehnae sak hanelah kakâcainaw teh
yonpen lah ao awh han.
Hawihoehnae ni tami caksak boi hoeh,
hatei tamikalan e adu teh tahruet thai lah awm hoeh.
Napui kahawi teh a vâ hanelah bawilukhung lah ao,
hatei yeirai ka po sak e napui teh
a vâ e hru ka hmawnsakkung doeh.
Tamikalan pouknae teh a lan,
hatei tamikathoutnaw e pouknae teh dumyennae doeh.
Tamikathoutnaw e lawk teh,
thei hanelah pawm awh sei, tie hah doeh.
Hatei tamikalan e pahni ni teh a rungngang han.
Tamikathout teh tâkhawng lah ao teh awm hoeh toe,
hatei tamikalan e imthung teh a cak han.
Tami a lung a ang awh e patetlah rip oup lah ao,
hatei a lungthin ka longkawi e teh dudam lah ao han.
Amahoima a kâoup teh ca hane kaawm hoeh e tami hlak teh,
apinihai oup laipalah mae thaw duem ka tawk e bet ahawihnawn.
Tamikalan ni teh amae saringnaw hah a pasai,
hatei tamikathout teh a pahrennae dawk patenghai a moikai.
Amae laikawk ka thawn e ni kaboumlah a ca han,
hatei ayawmyin lah kho ka sak e tami teh
thaipanueknae ka tawn hoeh e tami doeh.
Tamikathout ni tamikathoutnaw e tangkhek hah a doun awh,
hatei tamikalannaw e kung ni teh apaw a paw sak.
Tamikathout teh amae eknae dawk ouk a kâman,
hatei tamikalan teh runae thung hoi ouk a hlout.
Tami ni amae pahnipaw hah kaboumlah a ca han,
amae a kut hoi a tawk e a paw hai poe lah ao han.
Tamipathu ni amae lamthung hah kalan poung e lah a pouk,
hatei pouknae poe e ka ngâi e tami teh a lungkaang e doeh.
Tamipathu e lungkhueknae teh tang a kamnue,
hatei kahawicalah kho ka pouk e ni teh kayanae hah ouk a ramuk.
Lawkkatang ka dei e ni lannae a kamnue sak,
hatei kapanuekkhaikung kaphawk niteh
kadumyennaw hah a kamnue sak.
Tahloi hoi thut e patetlah lawk ka dei e ao awh,
hatei tami lungkaangnaw e lawk ni teh a dam sak.
Lawkkatang pahni teh a yungyoe caksak lah ao han,
hatei laithoe deinae lai teh dongdengca hanelah doeh.
Hawihoehnae pouknae lungthin dawk dumyennae ao,
hatei roumnae kadeikungnaw ni konawmnae a tawn awh.
Tamikalan koe thoenae phat mahoeh,
hatei tamikathout teh thoenae hoi a kawi han.
Laithoe pahni teh BAWIPA ni a hmuhma e doeh,
hatei kalan lah ka tawk e teh lunghawikhai e lah ao.
Kho ka pouk thai e tami ni teh a panue e patenghai a hro rah,
hatei tamipathu e lungthin ni teh pathunae dueng doeh a pâpho.
Tami ka hratbat e kut ni a uk han,
hatei ka pangak e teh lawkceng vaiteh
thama lahoi tawk sak lah ao han.
Khopouk papnae ni lungmathoenae a tâco sak,
hatei lawkkahawi ni tami konawm sak.
Tamikalan ni teh a imri hah lamthung a patue,
tamikathout ni teh lam a phen sak.
Tami ka pangak niteh, kahrawng a cei ei,
moi thokhai e boehai cat mahoeh.
Lannae lamthung dawk hringnae ao teh,
hote lamthung dawk teh duenae awm hoe.
